reason: A remote skill provider and installer for DeepSeek Harness that discovers skills from skills.sh and public GitHub repositories, loads them on demand, and installs bundles locally.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供从 skills.sh 和公开 GitHub 仓库发现、按需加载并安装远程技能的能力。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with discovery, on-demand loading, and local installation of skills from skills.sh and public GitHub repositories.

capabilities: Discovers skills from skills.sh and public GitHub sources
Fetches remote skill files over the network
Installs validated skill bundles into the local DeepSeek Harness skills directory
